items.prompt: In classic Verilog, continuous assign drives…
items.explain: Continuous assign is for nets; procedural blocks drive variables (reg).

items.prompt: always @(*) y = a & b requires y to be declared as…
items.explain: Procedural assignment targets a variable — reg in classic Verilog.

items.prompt: reg always means a flip-flop in hardware.
items.explain: Combo always @(*) also uses reg; clocked always may infer a FF.

items.prompt: assign y = a & b with y declared reg is…
items.explain: You cannot continuous-assign a reg — use wire or switch to always.
